title: Document Readiness Index methodology
samplingFrame: 100 public application-checklist or document-guidance sources; 25 each for rental, employment/income verification, mortgage/home loan, and small-business funding.

codingLevels.catalog: URL, organization, category, source type, format, and access date
codingLevels.deep: Specific preparation signals only for primary sources marked deepContentCoding=true

admissionRules: Relevant to an application, verification, loan, rental, or funding document process
Item-level findings require deep review flag
exclusions: Duplicate mirrors where a primary source was available
limitations: The 100-source catalog records public source metadata and URLs. Most records were not coded line-by-line in this release.
Only records marked deepContentCoding=true support item-level preparation-signal findings.
Requirements change by requester, jurisdiction, program, and date.
The report does not measure approval odds, market share, ranking, or applicant outcomes.
